# simplemdm_installed_app_action (Resource)

Triggers a one-shot action against an installed app on a device. Supported actions: 'update' (push update), 'request_management' (request MDM management of an unmanaged app), 'uninstall' (DELETE the install record).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "simplemdm_installed_app_action" "force_update" {
  installed_app_id = "6632"
  action           = "update"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Required. One of `update`, `request_management`, `uninstall`.
- `installed_app_id` (String) Required. Installed app ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier `<installed_app_id>:<action>:<unix_nanos>`.
- `last_triggered` (String)
